6.  designing a mechanism in which a hammer struck the string rather
7.  than plucking it, then immediately moved away to let the string

16. hammer mechanism made possible.

18. constantly with its design, lengthening the strings, strengthening
19. the frame, and adding pedals that could sustain or soften notes at
20. the performer's command.
21.     A crucial structural advance came with the introduction of a
22. solid metal frame, which allowed strings to be tightened far more
23. than a wooden frame could safely withstand, producing a louder,
24. richer tone capable of filling large concert halls.
25.     By the nineteenth century, the instrument had become a central
26. fixture of middle-class households, valued both for entertainment
27. and as a symbol of cultural refinement.
28.     Manufacturing improvements eventually made instruments
29. affordable enough for widespread ownership, while smaller upright
30. designs made the instrument practical even in modest living spaces.

32. countless sounds, the mechanical instrument remains a standard

questions.question: Choose the correctly transformed sentence(s).
questions.hint: «Tell» պահանջում է ուղղակի խնդիր, գիտական/ընդհանուր փաստերը մնում են ներկա ժամանակով:
solution_steps: Ա սխալ է՝ «told» պահանջում է «told me»։ Բ, Գ, Դ, Ե ճիշտ են։
statements:
Ա) "By the time you arrived, we had already annotated the proof," Owen said.
Owen told that by the time I had arrived, they had already annotated the proof.

Բ) "Can you explain why the word counts don't match?" Farah asked the copy editor.
Farah asked the copy editor if they could explain why the word counts didn't match.

Գ) Leo said to Ana: "I'm sure the editor-in-chief will approve the manuscript."
Leo assured Ana that the editor-in-chief would approve the manuscript.

Դ) The editor-in-chief said to the editors, "Serif fonts improve readability in print."
The editor-in-chief told the editors that serif fonts improve readability in print.

Ե) The junior editorial assistant begged the editor-in-chief to explain everything about the new style policy.
"I beg you to explain everything about the new style policy," said the junior editorial assistant.

questions.question: Choose the correctly transformed sentence(s).
questions.hint: Ստուգել, թե ով է իրականում կատարում խնդրանքի գործողությունը բնօրինակում:
solution_steps: Ա, Բ, Գ, Դ ճիշտ են։ Ե սխալ է՝ բնօրինակում editor-in-chiefն ասում է Նուրին, ուստի ճիշտ է «Noor's editor-in-chief told Noor to ask Priya...»։
statements:
Ա) "I've just edited the manuscript. Everything's final," Grace said.
Grace told James that she had just edited the manuscript and added that everything was final.

Բ) "What time will the editorial meeting start next Monday?" the editors asked the copy editor.
The editors asked the copy editor what time the editorial meeting would start the following Monday.

Գ) "Once the rebranding is finalized, editors won't be reassigned," the editor-in-chief said.
The editor-in-chief stated that once the rebranding was finalized, editors wouldn't be reassigned.

Դ) Victor apologized to Elena for interrupting her editorial meeting the day before.
"I'm sorry for interrupting your editorial meeting yesterday," Victor said to Elena.

Ե) "If you plan to visit the print shop, ask Priya to escort you," the editor-in-chief said to Noor.
Noor's editor-in-chief asked Priya to escort her if she planned to visit the print shop.

questions.question: Choose the correctly transformed sentence(s).
questions.hint: Առաջին տիպի պայմանական նախադասությունների անուղղակի ձևում «if»-ը հետշարժվում է պարզ անցյալով:
solution_steps: Ա, Գ, Դ, Ե ճիշտ են։ Բ սխալ է՝ ճիշտ է «if he didn't confirm», ոչ «hadn't confirmed»։
statements:

Dr. Reyes said that they would edit the manuscript at the print shop in two days' time.

Բ) "If you don't confirm the print slot today, the release date will change," Priya said to Tom.
Priya told Tom that the release date would change if he hadn't confirmed the print slot today.

Գ) My colleague warned me not to skip the fact-check as it would compromise the manuscript.
"Don't skip the fact-check; it will compromise the manuscript," my colleague said to me.

Դ) Farid said, "I will accept the book deal which is offered to me."
Farid said that he would accept the book deal which was offered to him.

Ե) "Will either Nadia or Omar edit the manuscript tomorrow?" Rosa asked.
Rosa asked Nadia whether she or Omar would edit the manuscript the following day.

questions.question: Choose the correctly transformed sentence(s).
questions.hint: Համեմատել բնօրինակի իմաստը («must I» = պարտադրանքի մասին հարց) վերակառուցված ձևի հետ:
solution_steps: Բ, Գ, Ե ճիշտ են։ Ա սխալ է՝ «says» ներկա է, մինչդեռ շրջանակը անցյալում է։ Դ սխալ է՝ ճիշտ է «whether he had to submit»։
statements:

The editor-in-chief says to Priya, "Would you mind staying at the print shop until the end of the shift?"

Բ) "I have been editing the manuscript for two weeks. I need to finish it today," Diego said.
Diego said he had been editing the manuscript for two weeks to finish it that day.

Գ) Hana told me that she would like to join the mentorship program.
Hana said to me, "I would like to join the mentorship program."

Դ) Tariq asked his editor-in-chief, "Must I submit the manuscript tonight?"
Tariq asked his editor-in-chief to submit the manuscript that night.

Ե) The editorial assistant said to Lena, "When does the contract expire?"
The editorial assistant asked Lena when the contract expired.

questions.question: Choose the correctly transformed sentence(s).
questions.hint: Ստուգել ժամանակաձևի հետշարժը և բային հաջորդող կառուցվածքը (գերունդ/infinitive):
solution_steps: Ա, Բ, Դ ճիշտ են։ Գ սխալ է՝ «says» ներկա է, մինչդեռ շրջանակն արդեն անցյալում է («asked»)։ Ե սխալ է՝ «suggest» պահանջում է գերունդ, ոչ infinitive։
statements:
Ա) "Why did you cancel the shoot at the last minute?" the director asked the production assistant.
The director asked the production assistant why they had cancelled the shoot at the last minute.

Բ) "Don't assume that the cinematographer will revise the script," Sara said to me.
Sara warned me not to assume that the cinematographer would revise the script.

Գ) Ben asked me to storyboard the scene.

Ե) "It's quite tight. Maybe we should postpone the table read," Nadia said.
Nadia suggested to postpone the table read as it was quite tight.
